body.asks: Whether an act's line stays flat as today, at, blocks, gone and says, with predecessor for parent, and its content hash worked out from those four alone rather than written beside them.
How a line says which of an act's blocks are this store's: an own list of their hashes, written only when the act wrote to other stores too.

Whether a store's table keeps each block's count of new holons, so it says it may hold an id only within a run it wrote, since an act's ids are minted together across stores; old checkpoints, without counts, read as they are.

name: A store holds only its own runs

body.asks: That a holon kept in two stores has its new version written in each, each line with its own store's prev, so one act writes different blocks for one holon and the content hash covers them all.

name: One holon's version in two stores

body.asks: That the format writes an act to the stores it is given, each with the holons it keeps, blocks then lines then refs, and leaves which store keeps what to the engine.

name: What the format's act is given
